2	"""Evaluate contrastive direction vectors on held-out test pairs.
3	
4	Input:
5	  --directions  directions.pt from compute_directions.py
6	  --activations activations.pt from extract_activations.py
7	  --output-dir  directory for JSON report
8	
9	Output:
10	  evaluation_report.json — per-layer AUROC, cosine similarity, stratified
11	                           breakdown, Go/No-Go verdict
12	  Human-readable summary printed to stdout
13	
14	Deps: torch, numpy, sklearn
15	"""
16	
17	import argparse
18	import json
19	import logging
20	import sys
21	from collections import defaultdict
22	from pathlib import Path
23	
24	import numpy as np
25	import torch
26	from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
27	
28	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
29	
30	
31	def load_test_samples(
32	    activations_path: str, test_pair_ids: list[str]
33	) -> list[dict]:
34	    """Load activation records and keep only those in the test set."""
35	    records = torch.load(activations_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
36	    test_set = set(test_pair_ids)
37	    filtered = [r for r in records if r["pair_id"] in test_set]
38	    logger.info(
39	        "Loaded %d total records; %d belong to test set (%d test pair_ids)",
40	        len(records), len(filtered), len(test_set),
41	    )
42	    return filtered
43	
44	
45	def compute_auroc_per_layer(
46	    samples: list[dict], d_syc: torch.Tensor
47	) -> dict[int, dict[int, float]]:
48	    """Compute AUROC per layer and token position.
49	
50	    For each sample, project its activation onto d_syc (dot product) to get a
51	    scalar score. Label: 1=invalid_pressure, 0=valid_correction.
52	
53	    Returns {layer_idx: {token_pos: auroc}}.
54	    """
55	    num_layers = d_syc.shape[0]
56	    num_positions = d_syc.shape[1]
57	
58	    labels = []
59	    # scores[layer][pos] -> list of floats
60	    scores: dict[int, dict[int, list]] = {
61	        l: {p: [] for p in range(num_positions)} for l in range(num_layers)
62	    }
63	
64	    for sample in samples:
65	        label = 1 if sample["condition"] == "invalid_pressure" else 0
66	        labels.append(label)
67	        acts = sample["activations"]  # (num_layers, 2, hidden_dim)
68	
69	        for layer in range(num_layers):
70	            for pos in range(num_positions):
71	                score = torch.dot(acts[layer, pos], d_syc[layer, pos]).item()
72	                scores[layer][pos].append(score)
73	
74	    labels_arr = np.array(labels)
75	    results = {}
76	    for layer in range(num_layers):
77	        results[layer] = {}
78	        for pos in range(num_positions):
79	            scores_arr = np.array(scores[layer][pos])
80	            if len(np.unique(labels_arr)) < 2:
81	                results[layer][pos] = float("nan")
82	            else:
83	                results[layer][pos] = roc_auc_score(labels_arr, scores_arr)
84	
85	    return results
86	
87	
88	def compute_cosine_per_layer(
89	    d_syc: torch.Tensor, d_gen: torch.Tensor
90	) -> dict[int, dict[int, float]]:
91	    """Compute cosine similarity between d_syc and d_gen per layer and token position."""
92	    num_layers = d_syc.shape[0]
93	    num_positions = d_syc.shape[1]
94	
95	    results = {}
96	    for layer in range(num_layers):
97	        results[layer] = {}
98	        for pos in range(num_positions):
99	            cos = torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(
100	                d_syc[layer, pos].unsqueeze(0),
101	                d_gen[layer, pos].unsqueeze(0),
102	            ).item()
103	            results[layer][pos] = cos
104	
105	    return results
106	
107	
108	def compute_stratified_auroc(
109	    samples: list[dict], d_syc: torch.Tensor, group_key: str, best_layer: int
110	) -> dict[str, dict[int, float]]:
111	    """Compute AUROC broken down by a metadata field (domain, evidence_strength, etc.).
112	
113	    Uses the best layer only, across all token positions.
114	    """
115	    num_positions = d_syc.shape[1]
116	
117	    groups: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
118	    for s in samples:
119	        groups[str(s[group_key])].append(s)
120	
121	    results = {}
122	    for group_val, group_samples in sorted(groups.items()):
123	        labels = []
124	        scores_by_pos: dict[int, list] = {p: [] for p in range(num_positions)}
125	
126	        for sample in group_samples:
127	            label = 1 if sample["condition"] == "invalid_pressure" else 0
128	            labels.append(label)
129	            for pos in range(num_positions):
130	                score = torch.dot(
131	                    sample["activations"][best_layer, pos], d_syc[best_layer, pos]
132	                ).item()
133	                scores_by_pos[pos].append(score)
134	
135	        labels_arr = np.array(labels)
136	        if len(np.unique(labels_arr)) < 2:
137	            results[group_val] = {p: float("nan") for p in range(num_positions)}
138	        else:
139	            results[group_val] = {
140	                p: roc_auc_score(labels_arr, np.array(scores_by_pos[p]))
141	                for p in range(num_positions)
142	            }
143	
144	    return results
145	
146	
147	def go_nogo_verdict(
148	    best_auroc: float, best_cosine: float,
149	    layer0_auroc: float = 0.5, layer0_delta: float = 1.0,
150	) -> dict:
151	    """Determine Go/No-Go based on v2 thresholds.
152	
153	    Criteria (all must hold for PASS):
154	      1. Best-layer AUROC >= 0.85
155	      2. Δ(best_layer - layer0) >= 0.15 (signal in model computation, not embedding)
156	      3. cosine(d_syc, d_gen) < 0.3
157	
158	    GRAY: AUROC in [0.80, 0.85) or Δ in [0.10, 0.15)
159	    FAIL: AUROC < 0.80 or Δ < 0.10
160	    """
161	    cosine_ok = best_cosine < 0.3
162	    delta_ok = layer0_delta >= 0.15
163	    delta_gray = layer0_delta >= 0.10
164	
165	    reasons = []
166	    if best_auroc >= 0.85 and delta_ok and cosine_ok:
167	        verdict = "PASS"
168	        reasons.append(f"AUROC={best_auroc:.4f} >= 0.85")
169	        reasons.append(f"Δ(best-layer0)={layer0_delta:.4f} >= 0.15")
170	        reasons.append(f"cosine={best_cosine:.4f} < 0.3")
171	    elif best_auroc < 0.80 or layer0_delta < 0.10:
172	        verdict = "FAIL"
173	        if best_auroc < 0.80:
174	            reasons.append(f"AUROC={best_auroc:.4f} < 0.80")
175	        if layer0_delta < 0.10:
176	            reasons.append(f"Δ(best-layer0)={layer0_delta:.4f} < 0.10 (confound risk)")
177	    else:
178	        verdict = "GRAY"
179	        if best_auroc < 0.85:
180	            reasons.append(f"AUROC={best_auroc:.4f} in [0.80, 0.85)")
181	        if not delta_ok:
182	            reasons.append(f"Δ(best-layer0)={layer0_delta:.4f} in [0.10, 0.15)")
183	        if not cosine_ok:
184	            reasons.append(f"cosine={best_cosine:.4f} >= 0.3")
185	
186	    return {
187	        "verdict": verdict,
188	        "reason": "; ".join(reasons),
189	        "auroc": best_auroc,
190	        "cosine": best_cosine,
191	        "layer0_auroc": layer0_auroc,
192	        "layer0_delta": layer0_delta,
193	    }
194	
195	
196	def main() -> None:
197	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
198	        description="Evaluate contrastive direction vectors on test set."
199	    )
200	    parser.add_argument(

202	    )
203	    parser.add_argument(

205	    )
206	    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", default=".", help="Output directory (default: .)")
207	    args = parser.parse_args()
208	
209	    logging.basicConfig(

211	        format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s",
212	    )

215	    directions = torch.load(args.directions, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
216	    d_syc = directions["d_syc"]
217	    d_gen = directions["d_gen"]
218	    test_pair_ids = directions["test_pair_ids"]
219	    metadata = directions["metadata"]
220	
221	    if not test_pair_ids:

225	    test_samples = load_test_samples(args.activations, test_pair_ids)
226	    if not test_samples:
227	        logger.error("No test samples found; exiting")
228	        sys.exit(1)
229	
230	    # Per-layer AUROC
231	    logger.info("Computing per-layer AUROC")
232	    auroc_per_layer = compute_auroc_per_layer(test_samples, d_syc)
233	
234	    # Find best layer (max AUROC across token positions)
235	    best_layer = -1
236	    best_auroc = -1.0
237	    best_pos = -1
238	    for layer, pos_dict in auroc_per_layer.items():
239	        for pos, auc in pos_dict.items():
240	            if not np.isnan(auc) and auc > best_auroc:
241	                best_auroc = auc
242	                best_layer = layer
243	                best_pos = pos
244	
245	    logger.info("Best layer=%d, pos=%d, AUROC=%.4f", best_layer, best_pos, best_auroc)
246	
247	    # Cosine similarity
248	    logger.info("Computing per-layer cosine similarity")
249	    cosine_per_layer = compute_cosine_per_layer(d_syc, d_gen)
250	    best_cosine = cosine_per_layer[best_layer][best_pos]
251	
252	    # Stratified analysis at best layer
253	    logger.info("Computing stratified AUROC breakdown")
254	    breakdown_domain = compute_stratified_auroc(test_samples, d_syc, "domain", best_layer)
255	    breakdown_evidence = compute_stratified_auroc(

265

274	        "best_cosine": best_cosine,
275	        "layer0_auroc": layer0_auroc,
276	        "layer0_delta": layer0_delta,

import argparse

from pathlib import Path

def load_and_group(path: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, dict]]:
    """Load activation records and group by pair_id.

    Returns {pair_id: {"warranted_revision": record, "sycophantic_capitulation": record}}.

        else:
            logger.warning(
                "Pair '%s' incomplete (conditions: %s); skipping", pid, list(conds.keys())
            )

    logger.info("Complete pairs: %d", len(complete))
    return complete


def stratified_split(
    pairs: dict[str, dict[str, dict]], test_ratio: float, seed: int
) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """Split pair_ids into train/test with stratification by domain.

    Uses StratifiedShuffleSplit so each domain's proportion is preserved
    across the split. The split unit is the pair (both conditions stay together).
    """
    pair_ids = sorted(pairs.keys())
    domains = [pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"]["domain"] for pid in pair_ids]

    for d in domains:

            min_count,

        rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
        idx = rng.permutation(len(pair_ids))

    domains_arr = np.array(domains)

    pairs: dict[str, dict[str, dict]],

) -> torch.Tensor:

    Returns L2-normalized direction of shape (num_layers, 2, hidden_dim).
    """
    pos_acts = []
    neg_acts = []
    for pid in pair_ids:
        pos_acts.append(pairs[pid][positive_condition]["activations"])
        neg_acts.append(pairs[pid][negative_condition]["activations"])

    # Stack: (N, num_layers, 2, hidden_dim)
    pos_mean = torch.stack(pos_acts).mean(dim=0)
    neg_mean = torch.stack(neg_acts).mean(dim=0)

    direction = pos_mean - neg_mean

    # L2 normalize per (layer, token_position) slice
    norms = direction.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-8)

    )

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bootstrap 95% CI for d_syc AUROC metrics.

Computes bootstrap CIs for:
1. Qwen3-8B 5-fold CV AUROC (style-controlled data, 181 pairs)
2. Qwen3-8B per-strength AUROC (weak/medium/strong)
3. Llama-3-8B 5-fold CV AUROC
4. d_syc vs random baseline AUROC difference
"""

import json
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

N_BOOTSTRAP = 10000
N_FOLDS = 5
SEED = 42


# ── Data loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_pairs(path, act_key="activations"):
    records = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    pairs = defaultdict(dict)
    for s in records:
        pairs[s["pair_id"]][s["condition"]] = s
    return {
        pid: conds
        for pid, conds in pairs.items()
        if "warranted_revision" in conds and "sycophantic_capitulation" in conds
    }


def prepare_arrays(pairs, act_key="activations", pos=None):
    """Pre-extract activations as numpy arrays for speed.

    Returns:
        syc: (n_pairs, n_layers, hidden_dim)
        wr:  (n_pairs, n_layers, hidden_dim)
        domains: list[str]
        strengths: list[str]
        pair_ids: list[str]
    """
    pair_ids = sorted(pairs.keys())
    syc_list, wr_list, domains, strengths = [], [], [], []

    for pid in pair_ids:
        s_act = pairs[pid]["sycophantic_capitulation"][act_key]
        w_act = pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"][act_key]
        if pos is not None:
            s_act = s_act[:, pos, :]
            w_act = w_act[:, pos, :]
        syc_list.append(s_act)
        wr_list.append(w_act)
        domains.append(pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"]["domain"])
        strengths.append(pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"]["evidence_strength"])

    syc = torch.stack(syc_list).numpy().astype(np.float32)
    wr = torch.stack(wr_list).numpy().astype(np.float32)
    return syc, wr, domains, strengths, pair_ids


# ── Core CV + AUROC ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def cv_auroc(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_folds=N_FOLDS, seed=SEED,

    """

    if layer_hi is None:
        layer_hi = syc.shape[1]

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
    fold_aurocs = []
    oof_scores = np.zeros(n_pairs)  # syc_score - wr_score per pair (for OOF)
    oof_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    oof_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)

    for train_idx, test_idx in skf.split(np.arange(n_pairs), domains_arr):
        d = syc[train_idx].mean(axis=0) - wr[train_idx].mean(axis=0)
        norms = np.linalg.norm(d, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        d = d / np.maximum(norms, 1e-8)

        # Vectorized scoring: (n_test, n_layers)
        s_test = (syc[test_idx] * d).sum(axis=-1)
        w_test = (wr[test_idx] * d).sum(axis=-1)

        best_auroc = -1.0
        best_layer = layer_lo
        for layer in range(layer_lo, layer_hi):
            scores = np.concatenate([s_test[:, layer], w_test[:, layer]])
            labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(test_idx)), np.zeros(len(test_idx))])
            try:
                auroc = roc_auc_score(labels, scores)
                if auroc > best_auroc:
                    best_auroc = auroc
                    best_layer = layer
            except ValueError:
                pass

        fold_aurocs.append(best_auroc)
        oof_syc[test_idx] = s_test[:, best_layer]
        oof_wr[test_idx] = w_test[:, best_layer]

    mean_auroc = float(np.mean(fold_aurocs))

    if return_oof:
        return mean_auroc, fold_aurocs, oof_syc, oof_wr
    return mean_auroc, fold_aurocs


# ── Bootstrap routines ───────────────────────────────────────────────

def bootstrap_cv_auroc(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP,
                       seed=SEED, layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None):
    """Bootstrap the 5-fold CV AUROC by resampling pairs."""
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n_pairs = syc.shape[0]
    aurocs = []

    for b in range(n_bootstrap):
        boot_idx = rng.choice(n_pairs, size=n_pairs, replace=True)
        boot_domains = domains_arr[boot_idx]

        # Ensure at least 2 unique domain values for stratification
        if len(np.unique(boot_domains)) < N_FOLDS:
            boot_domains = np.arange(n_pairs) % N_FOLDS

        try:
            mean_auc, _ = cv_auroc(
                syc[boot_idx], wr[boot_idx], boot_domains,
                seed=b, layer_lo=layer_lo, layer_hi=layer_hi,
            )
            aurocs.append(mean_auc)
        except Exception:
            pass

    aurocs = np.array(aurocs)
    return {
        "mean": float(np.mean(aurocs)),
        "std": float(np.std(aurocs)),
        "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 2.5)),
        "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 97.5)),
        "n_valid": len(aurocs),
    }


def bootstrap_oof_auroc(oof_syc, oof_wr, mask=None,
                         n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP, seed=SEED):
    """Bootstrap AUROC from OOF predictions by resampling pairs."""
    if mask is not None:
        oof_syc = oof_syc[mask]
        oof_wr = oof_wr[mask]

    n = len(oof_syc)
    if n < 4:
        return None

    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    aurocs = []

    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.choice(n, size=n, replace=True)
        scores = np.concatenate([oof_syc[idx], oof_wr[idx]])
        labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(idx)), np.zeros(len(idx))])
        try:
            aurocs.append(roc_auc_score(labels, scores))
        except ValueError:
            pass

    aurocs = np.array(aurocs)
    # Point estimate from full data
    full_scores = np.concatenate([oof_syc, oof_wr])
    full_labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(n), np.zeros(n)])
    point_auroc = float(roc_auc_score(full_labels, full_scores))

    return {
        "point_auroc": point_auroc,
        "bootstrap_mean": float(np.mean(aurocs)),
        "std": float(np.std(aurocs)),
        "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 2.5)),
        "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 97.5)),
        "n_pairs": n,
        "n_valid": len(aurocs),
    }


def bootstrap_auroc_difference(oof_syc_d, oof_wr_d, oof_syc_r, oof_wr_r,
                                n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP, seed=SEED):
    """Bootstrap CI for AUROC(d_syc) - AUROC(random)."""
    n = len(oof_syc_d)
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    diffs = []

    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.choice(n, size=n, replace=True)
        scores_d = np.concatenate([oof_syc_d[idx], oof_wr_d[idx]])
        scores_r = np.concatenate([oof_syc_r[idx], oof_wr_r[idx]])
        labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(idx)), np.zeros(len(idx))])
        try:
            a_d = roc_auc_score(labels, scores_d)
            a_r = roc_auc_score(labels, scores_r)
            diffs.append(a_d - a_r)
        except ValueError:
            pass

    diffs = np.array(diffs)
    return {
        "mean_diff": float(np.mean(diffs)),
        "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(diffs, 2.5)),
        "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(diffs, 97.5)),
        "p_greater_zero": float(np.mean(diffs > 0)),
        "n_valid": len(diffs),
    }


def random_direction_oof(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_random=200, seed=SEED,
                          layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None):
    """Compute mean AUROC of random directions (matched procedure to d_syc)."""
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n_pairs, n_layers, hidden = syc.shape
    if layer_hi is None:
        layer_hi = n_layers

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
    folds = list(skf.split(np.arange(n_pairs), domains_arr))

    random_aurocs = []
    best_oof_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    best_oof_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    best_overall = -1.0

    for r in range(n_random):
        d_rand = rng.randn(n_layers, hidden).astype(np.float32)
        norms = np.linalg.norm(d_rand, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        d_rand = d_rand / np.maximum(norms, 1e-8)

        fold_aurocs = []
        tmp_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
        tmp_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)

        for train_idx, test_idx in folds:
            s_test = (syc[test_idx] * d_rand).sum(axis=-1)
            w_test = (wr[test_idx] * d_rand).sum(axis=-1)

            best_a = -1.0
            best_l = layer_lo
            for layer in range(layer_lo, layer_hi):
                scores = np.concatenate([s_test[:, layer], w_test[:, layer]])
                labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(test_idx)), np.zeros(len(test_idx))])
                try:
                    a = roc_auc_score(labels, scores)
                    if a > best_a:
                        best_a = a
                        best_l = layer
                except ValueError:
                    pass

            fold_aurocs.append(best_a)
            tmp_syc[test_idx] = s_test[:, best_l]
            tmp_wr[test_idx] = w_test[:, best_l]

        mean_a = np.mean(fold_aurocs)
        random_aurocs.append(mean_a)
        if mean_a > best_overall:
            best_overall = mean_a
            best_oof_syc = tmp_syc.copy()
            best_oof_wr = tmp_wr.copy()

    return {
        "mean_auroc": float(np.mean(random_aurocs)),
        "std": float(np.std(random_aurocs)),
        "max_auroc": float(np.max(random_aurocs)),
        "n_random": n_random,
    }, best_oof_syc, best_oof_wr


# ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    results = {}

    # ── Qwen3-8B (exp001, 181 pairs, style-controlled) ────────────
    print("Loading Qwen3-8B data (181 pairs)...")
    qwen_pairs = load_pairs(
        "/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/results/exp001/activations.pt",
        act_key="activations",
    )
    syc_q, wr_q, domains_q, strengths_q, pids_q = prepare_arrays(
        qwen_pairs, act_key="activations", pos=1,  # asst_first
    )
    domains_q_arr = np.array(domains_q)
    strengths_q_arr = np.array(strengths_q)
    print(f"  {syc_q.shape[0]} pairs, {syc_q.shape[1]} layers, {syc_q.shape[2]} dim")

    # Point estimate: 5-fold CV
    print("Running Qwen 5-fold CV (point estimate)...")
    q_mean, q_folds, q_oof_syc, q_oof_wr = cv_auroc(
        syc_q, wr_q, domains_q_arr, return_oof=True,
    )
    print(f"  Mean CV AUROC = {q_mean:.4f}, folds = {[round(x, 4) for x in q_folds]}")

    results["qwen_cv"] = {
        "point_estimate": q_mean,
        "fold_aurocs": [round(x, 6) for x in q_folds],
        "fold_std": float(np.std(q_folds)),
        "n_pairs": int(syc_q.shape[0]),
    }

    # Bootstrap CI via OOF predictions (fast)
    print("Bootstrapping Qwen OOF AUROC (n=10000)...")
    q_oof_ci = bootstrap_oof_auroc(q_oof_syc, q_oof_wr, seed=SEED)
    results["qwen_cv"]["oof_bootstrap"] = q_oof_ci
    print(f"  OOF AUROC = {q_oof_ci['point_auroc']:.4f} "
          f"[{q_oof_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {q_oof_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}]")

    # Per-strength breakdown
    print("Bootstrapping Qwen per-strength AUROC...")
    results["qwen_per_strength"] = {}
    for strength in ["weak", "medium", "strong"]:
        mask = strengths_q_arr == strength
        ci = bootstrap_oof_auroc(q_oof_syc, q_oof_wr, mask=mask, seed=SEED)
        if ci:

    q_full_ci = bootstrap_cv_auroc(syc_q, wr_q, domains_q_arr, seed=SEED)

          f"[{l_full_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {l_full_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}]")
    print("│")
    print("│ Per-strength (OOF):")
    for s in ["weak", "medium", "strong"]:
        ci = results["llama_per_strength"].get(s)
        if ci:
            print(f"│   {s:8s}: {ci['point_auroc']:.4f} "
                  f"[{ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}] (n={ci['n_pairs']})")
    print("└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘")

    print(f"\n┌─ d_syc vs random baseline (Qwen) ───────────────────────────────┐")
    print(f"│ d_syc AUROC:  {q_oof_ci['point_auroc']:.4f}")
    print(f"│ Random AUROC: {rand_stats['mean_auroc']:.4f} (mean of {rand_stats['n_random']} random dirs)")
    print(f"│ Δ(d_syc - random) = {diff_ci['mean_diff']:.4f} "
          f"[{diff_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {diff_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}]")
    print(f"│ P(d_syc > random) = {diff_ci['p_greater_zero']:.4f}")
    print("└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘")

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f"\nTotal time: {elapsed:.1f}s")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bootstrap 95% CI for d_syc AUROC metrics.

Computes bootstrap CIs for:
1. Qwen3-8B 5-fold CV AUROC (style-controlled data, 181 pairs)
2. Qwen3-8B per-strength AUROC (weak/medium/strong)
3. Llama-3-8B 5-fold CV AUROC
4. d_syc vs random baseline AUROC difference
"""

import json
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

N_BOOTSTRAP = 10000
N_FOLDS = 5
SEED = 42


# ── Data loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_pairs(path, act_key="activations"):
    records = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    pairs = defaultdict(dict)
    for s in records:
        pairs[s["pair_id"]][s["condition"]] = s
    return {
        pid: conds
        for pid, conds in pairs.items()
        if "warranted_revision" in conds and "sycophantic_capitulation" in conds
    }


def prepare_arrays(pairs, act_key="activations", pos=None):
    """Pre-extract activations as numpy arrays for speed.

    Returns:
        syc: (n_pairs, n_layers, hidden_dim)
        wr:  (n_pairs, n_layers, hidden_dim)
        domains: list[str]
        strengths: list[str]
        pair_ids: list[str]
    """
    pair_ids = sorted(pairs.keys())
    syc_list, wr_list, domains, strengths = [], [], [], []

    for pid in pair_ids:
        s_act = pairs[pid]["sycophantic_capitulation"][act_key]
        w_act = pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"][act_key]
        if pos is not None:
            s_act = s_act[:, pos, :]
            w_act = w_act[:, pos, :]
        syc_list.append(s_act)
        wr_list.append(w_act)
        domains.append(pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"]["domain"])
        strengths.append(pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"]["evidence_strength"])

    syc = torch.stack(syc_list).numpy().astype(np.float32)
    wr = torch.stack(wr_list).numpy().astype(np.float32)
    return syc, wr, domains, strengths, pair_ids


# ── Core CV + AUROC ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def cv_auroc(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_folds=N_FOLDS, seed=SEED,
             layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None, return_oof=False):
    """Run stratified 5-fold CV and return mean AUROC (and optionally OOF scores).

    For each fold: compute d_syc from train, search best layer on test, record AUROC.
    """
    n_pairs = syc.shape[0]
    if layer_hi is None:
        layer_hi = syc.shape[1]

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
    fold_aurocs = []
    oof_scores = np.zeros(n_pairs)  # syc_score - wr_score per pair (for OOF)
    oof_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    oof_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)

    for train_idx, test_idx in skf.split(np.arange(n_pairs), domains_arr):
        d = syc[train_idx].mean(axis=0) - wr[train_idx].mean(axis=0)
        norms = np.linalg.norm(d, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        d = d / np.maximum(norms, 1e-8)

        # Vectorized scoring: (n_test, n_layers)
        s_test = (syc[test_idx] * d).sum(axis=-1)
        w_test = (wr[test_idx] * d).sum(axis=-1)

        best_auroc = -1.0
        best_layer = layer_lo
        for layer in range(layer_lo, layer_hi):
            scores = np.concatenate([s_test[:, layer], w_test[:, layer]])
            labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(test_idx)), np.zeros(len(test_idx))])
            try:
                auroc = roc_auc_score(labels, scores)
                if auroc > best_auroc:
                    best_auroc = auroc
                    best_layer = layer
            except ValueError:
                pass

        fold_aurocs.append(best_auroc)
        oof_syc[test_idx] = s_test[:, best_layer]
        oof_wr[test_idx] = w_test[:, best_layer]

    mean_auroc = float(np.mean(fold_aurocs))

    if return_oof:
        return mean_auroc, fold_aurocs, oof_syc, oof_wr
    return mean_auroc, fold_aurocs


# ── Bootstrap routines ───────────────────────────────────────────────

def bootstrap_cv_auroc(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP,
                       seed=SEED, layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None):
    """Bootstrap the 5-fold CV AUROC by resampling pairs."""
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n_pairs = syc.shape[0]
    aurocs = []

    for b in range(n_bootstrap):
        boot_idx = rng.choice(n_pairs, size=n_pairs, replace=True)
        boot_domains = domains_arr[boot_idx]

        # Ensure at least 2 unique domain values for stratification
        if len(np.unique(boot_domains)) < N_FOLDS:
            boot_domains = np.arange(n_pairs) % N_FOLDS

        try:
            mean_auc, _ = cv_auroc(
                syc[boot_idx], wr[boot_idx], boot_domains,
                seed=b, layer_lo=layer_lo, layer_hi=layer_hi,
            )
            aurocs.append(mean_auc)
        except Exception:
            pass

    aurocs = np.array(aurocs)
    return {
        "mean": float(np.mean(aurocs)),
        "std": float(np.std(aurocs)),
        "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 2.5)),
        "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 97.5)),
        "n_valid": len(aurocs),
    }


def bootstrap_oof_auroc(oof_syc, oof_wr, mask=None,
                         n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP, seed=SEED):
    """Bootstrap AUROC from OOF predictions by resampling pairs."""
    if mask is not None:
        oof_syc = oof_syc[mask]
        oof_wr = oof_wr[mask]

    n = len(oof_syc)
    if n < 4:
        return None

    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    aurocs = []

    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.choice(n, size=n, replace=True)
        scores = np.concatenate([oof_syc[idx], oof_wr[idx]])
        labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(idx)), np.zeros(len(idx))])
        try:
            aurocs.append(roc_auc_score(labels, scores))
        except ValueError:
            pass

    aurocs = np.array(aurocs)
    # Point estimate from full data
    full_scores = np.concatenate([oof_syc, oof_wr])
    full_labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(n), np.zeros(n)])
    point_auroc = float(roc_auc_score(full_labels, full_scores))

    return {
        "point_auroc": point_auroc,
        "bootstrap_mean": float(np.mean(aurocs)),
        "std": float(np.std(aurocs)),
        "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 2.5)),
        "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 97.5)),
        "n_pairs": n,
        "n_valid": len(aurocs),
    }


def bootstrap_auroc_difference(oof_syc_d, oof_wr_d, oof_syc_r, oof_wr_r,
                                n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP, seed=SEED):
    """Bootstrap CI for AUROC(d_syc) - AUROC(random)."""
    n = len(oof_syc_d)
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    diffs = []

    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.choice(n, size=n, replace=True)
        scores_d = np.concatenate([oof_syc_d[idx], oof_wr_d[idx]])
        scores_r = np.concatenate([oof_syc_r[idx], oof_wr_r[idx]])
        labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(idx)), np.zeros(len(idx))])
        try:
            a_d = roc_auc_score(labels, scores_d)
            a_r = roc_auc_score(labels, scores_r)
            diffs.append(a_d - a_r)
        except ValueError:
            pass

    diffs = np.array(diffs)
    return {
        "mean_diff": float(np.mean(diffs)),
        "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(diffs, 2.5)),
        "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(diffs, 97.5)),
        "p_greater_zero": float(np.mean(diffs > 0)),
        "n_valid": len(diffs),
    }


def random_direction_oof(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_random=200, seed=SEED,
                          layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None):
    """Compute mean AUROC of random directions (matched procedure to d_syc)."""
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n_pairs, n_layers, hidden = syc.shape
    if layer_hi is None:
        layer_hi = n_layers

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
    folds = list(skf.split(np.arange(n_pairs), domains_arr))

    random_aurocs = []
    best_oof_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    best_oof_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    best_overall = -1.0

    for r in range(n_random):
        d_rand = rng.randn(n_layers, hidden).astype(np.float32)
        norms = np.linalg.norm(d_rand, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        d_rand = d_rand / np.maximum(norms, 1e-8)

        fold_aurocs = []
        tmp_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
        tmp_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)

        for train_idx, test_idx in folds:
            s_test = (syc[test_idx] * d_rand).sum(axis=-1)
            w_test = (wr[test_idx] * d_rand).sum(axis=-1)

            best_a = -1.0
            best_l = layer_lo
            for layer in range(layer_lo, layer_hi):
                scores = np.concatenate([s_test[:, layer], w_test[:, layer]])
                labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(test_idx)), np.zeros(len(test_idx))])
                try:
                    a = roc_auc_score(labels, scores)
                    if a > best_a:
                        best_a = a
                        best_l = layer
                except ValueError:
                    pass

            fold_aurocs.append(best_a)
            tmp_syc[test_idx] = s_test[:, best_l]
            tmp_wr[test_idx] = w_test[:, best_l]

        mean_a = np.mean(fold_aurocs)
        random_aurocs.append(mean_a)
        if mean_a > best_overall:
            best_overall = mean_a
            best_oof_syc = tmp_syc.copy()
            best_oof_wr = tmp_wr.copy()

    return {
        "mean_auroc": float(np.mean(random_aurocs)),
        "std": float(np.std(random_aurocs)),
        "max_auroc": float(np.max(random_aurocs)),
        "n_random": n_random,
    }, best_oof_syc, best_oof_wr


# ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    results = {}

    # ── Qwen3-8B (exp001, 181 pairs, style-controlled) ────────────
    print("Loading Qwen3-8B data (181 pairs)...")
    qwen_pairs = load_pairs(
        "/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/results/exp001/activations.pt",
        act_key="activations",
    )
    syc_q, wr_q, domains_q, strengths_q, pids_q = prepare_arrays(
        qwen_pairs, act_key="activations", pos=1,  # asst_first
    )
    domains_q_arr = np.array(domains_q)
    strengths_q_arr = np.array(strengths_q)
    print(f"  {syc_q.shape[0]} pairs, {syc_q.shape[1]} layers, {syc_q.shape[2]} dim")

    # Point estimate: 5-fold CV
    print("Running Qwen 5-fold CV (point estimate)...")
    q_mean, q_folds, q_oof_syc, q_oof_wr = cv_auroc(
        syc_q, wr_q, domains_q_arr, return_oof=True,
    )
    print(f"  Mean CV AUROC = {q_mean:.4f}, folds = {[round(x, 4) for x in q_folds]}")

    results["qwen_cv"] = {
        "point_estimate": q_mean,
        "fold_aurocs": [round(x, 6) for x in q_folds],
        "fold_std": float(np.std(q_folds)),
        "n_pairs": int(syc_q.shape[0]),
    }

    # Bootstrap CI via OOF predictions (fast)
    print("Bootstrapping Qwen OOF AUROC (n=10000)...")
    q_oof_ci = bootstrap_oof_auroc(q_oof_syc, q_oof_wr, seed=SEED)
    results["qwen_cv"]["oof_bootstrap"] = q_oof_ci
    print(f"  OOF AUROC = {q_oof_ci['point_auroc']:.4f} "
          f"[{q_oof_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {q_oof_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}]")

    # Per-strength breakdown
    print("Bootstrapping Qwen per-strength AUROC...")
    results["qwen_per_strength"] = {}
    for strength in ["weak", "medium", "strong"]:
        mask = strengths_q_arr == strength
        ci = bootstrap_oof_auroc(q_oof_syc, q_oof_wr, mask=mask, seed=SEED)
        if ci:
            results["qwen_per_strength"][strength] = ci
            print(f"  {strength}: AUROC = {ci['point_auroc']:.4f} "
                  f"[{ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}] "
                  f"(n={ci['n_pairs']})")

    # Full bootstrap-of-CV (slower but more rigorous)
    print("Bootstrapping Qwen full CV (n=10000, this takes a while)...")
    q_full_ci = bootstrap_cv_auroc(syc_q, wr_q, domains_q_arr, seed=SEED)
    results["qwen_cv"]["full_cv_bootstrap"] = q_full_ci
    print(f"  Full CV bootstrap: {q_full_ci['mean']:.4f} "
          f"[{q_full_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {q_full_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}]")
    print(f"  Elapsed: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s")

    # ── Llama-3-8B (exp012, 181 pairs) ────────────────────────────
    print("\nLoading Llama-3-8B data (181 pairs)...")
    llama_pairs = load_pairs(
        "/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/results/exp012_llama_direction/activations.pt",
        act_key="activation",
    )
    syc_l, wr_l, domains_l, strengths_l, pids_l = prepare_arrays(

    )
    domains_l_arr = np.array(domains_l)
    strengths_l_arr = np.array(strengths_l)
    print(f"  {syc_l.shape[0]} pairs, {syc_l.shape[1]} layers, {syc_l.shape[2]} dim")

    # Point estimate
    print("Running Llama 5-fold CV...")
    l_mean, l_folds, l_oof_syc, l_oof_wr = cv_auroc(
        syc_l, wr_l, domains_l_arr, return_oof=True,
    )
    print(f"  Mean CV AUROC = {l_mean:.4f}, folds = {[round(x, 4) for x in l_folds]}")

    results["llama_cv"] = {
        "point_estimate": l_mean,
        "fold_aurocs": [round(x, 6) for x in l_folds],
        "fold_std": float(np.std(l_folds)),
        "n_pairs": int(syc_l.shape[0]),
    }

    # Bootstrap OOF
    print("Bootstrapping Llama OOF AUROC (n=10000)...")
    l_oof_ci = bootstrap_oof_auroc(l_oof_syc, l_oof_wr, seed=SEED)
    results["llama_cv"]["oof_bootstrap"] = l_oof_ci
    print(f"  OOF AUROC = {l_oof_ci['point_auroc']:.4f} "
          f"[{l_oof_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {l_oof_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}]")

    # Llama per-strength
    print("Bootstrapping Llama per-strength AUROC...")

    for strength in ["weak", "medium", "strong"]:

    print(f"  Full CV bootstrap: {l_full_ci['mean']:.4f} "
          f"[{l_full_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {l_full_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}]")

    # ── d_syc vs random baseline (Qwen) ──────────────────────────
    print("\nComputing random baseline (200 random directions)...")
    rand_stats, rand_oof_syc, rand_oof_wr = random_direction_oof(

    )
    results["random_baseline_qwen"] = rand_stats
    print(f"  Random AUROC: mean={rand_stats['mean_auroc']:.4f}, "
          f"max={rand_stats['max_auroc']:.4f}")

    # Bootstrap difference CI
    print("Bootstrapping d_syc vs random AUROC difference...")
    diff_ci = bootstrap_auroc_difference(
        q_oof_syc, q_oof_wr, rand_oof_syc, rand_oof_wr, seed=SEED,
    )
    results["dsyc_vs_random_qwen"] = {
        "dsyc_auroc": q_oof_ci["point_auroc"],
        "random_auroc": rand_stats["mean_auroc"],
        "difference_ci": diff_ci,
    }
    print(f"  AUROC diff = {diff_ci['mean_diff']:.4f} "
          f"[{diff_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {diff_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}], "
          f"P(diff>0) = {diff_ci['p_greater_zero']:.4f}")

    # ── Save results ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    out_dir = Path("/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/artifacts")
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = out_dir / "bootstrap_auroc_ci.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {out_path}")

    # ── Human-readable summary ────────────────────────────────────
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("BOOTSTRAP 95% CI SUMMARY (n_bootstrap=10000)")
    print("=" * 70)

    print("\n┌─ Qwen3-8B (style-controlled, 181 pairs) ─────────────────────────┐")
    print(f"│ 5-fold CV AUROC = {q_mean:.4f} (std={np.std(q_folds):.4f})")
    print(f"│ OOF bootstrap:  {q_oof_ci['point_auroc']:.4f} "
          f"[{q_oof_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {q_oof_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}]")
    print(f"│ Full CV bootstrap: {q_full_ci['mean']:.4f} "

    print("└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘")

    print(f"\n┌─ d_syc vs random baseline (Qwen) ───────────────────────────────┐")
    print(f"│ d_syc AUROC:  {q_oof_ci['point_auroc']:.4f}")
    print(f"│ Random AUROC: {rand_stats['mean_auroc']:.4f} (mean of {rand_stats['n_random']} random dirs)")
    print(f"│ Δ(d_syc - random) = {diff_ci['mean_diff']:.4f} "
          f"[{diff_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {diff_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}]")
    print(f"│ P(d_syc > random) = {diff_ci['p_greater_zero']:.4f}")
    print("└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘")

    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    print(f"\nTotal time: {elapsed:.1f}s")

    main()

46	        wr:  (n_pairs, n_layers, hidden_dim)
47	        domains: list[str]

51	    pair_ids = sorted(pairs.keys())
52	    syc_list, wr_list, domains, strengths = [], [], [], []
53	
54	    for pid in pair_ids:
55	        s_act = pairs[pid]["sycophantic_capitulation"][act_key]
56	        w_act = pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"][act_key]

73	             layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None, return_oof=False):
74	    """Run stratified 5-fold CV and return mean AUROC (and optionally OOF scores).
75	
76	    For each fold: compute d_syc from train, search best layer on test, record AUROC.
77	    """
78	    n_pairs = syc.shape[0]
79	    if layer_hi is None:
80	        layer_hi = syc.shape[1]
81	
82	    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
83	    fold_aurocs = []
84	    oof_scores = np.zeros(n_pairs)  # syc_score - wr_score per pair (for OOF)

90	        norms = np.linalg.norm(d, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
91	        d = d / np.maximum(norms, 1e-8)
92	
93	        # Vectorized scoring: (n_test, n_layers)
94	        s_test = (syc[test_idx] * d).sum(axis=-1)
95	        w_test = (wr[test_idx] * d).sum(axis=-1)
96	
97	        best_auroc = -1.0
98	        best_layer = layer_lo

114	    mean_auroc = float(np.mean(fold_aurocs))

116	    if return_oof:

140	                syc[boot_idx], wr[boot_idx], boot_domains,
141	                seed=b, layer_lo=layer_lo, layer_hi=layer_hi,
142	            )

146	
147	    aurocs = np.array(aurocs)
148	    return {

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bootstrap 95% CI for d_syc AUROC metrics.

Computes bootstrap CIs for:
1. Qwen3-8B 5-fold CV AUROC (style-controlled data, 181 pairs)
2. Qwen3-8B per-strength AUROC (weak/medium/strong)
3. Llama-3-8B 5-fold CV AUROC
4. d_syc vs random baseline AUROC difference
"""

import json
import sys
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

N_BOOTSTRAP = 10000
N_FOLDS = 5
SEED = 42


# ── Data loading ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_pairs(path, act_key="activations"):
    records = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    pairs = defaultdict(dict)
    for s in records:
        pairs[s["pair_id"]][s["condition"]] = s
    return {
        pid: conds
        for pid, conds in pairs.items()
        if "warranted_revision" in conds and "sycophantic_capitulation" in conds
    }


def prepare_arrays(pairs, act_key="activations", pos=None):
    """Pre-extract activations as numpy arrays for speed.

    Returns:
        syc: (n_pairs, n_layers, hidden_dim)
        wr:  (n_pairs, n_layers, hidden_dim)
        domains: list[str]
        strengths: list[str]
        pair_ids: list[str]
    """
    pair_ids = sorted(pairs.keys())
    syc_list, wr_list, domains, strengths = [], [], [], []

    for pid in pair_ids:
        s_act = pairs[pid]["sycophantic_capitulation"][act_key]
        w_act = pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"][act_key]
        if pos is not None:
            s_act = s_act[:, pos, :]
            w_act = w_act[:, pos, :]
        syc_list.append(s_act)
        wr_list.append(w_act)
        domains.append(pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"]["domain"])
        strengths.append(pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"]["evidence_strength"])

    syc = torch.stack(syc_list).numpy().astype(np.float32)
    wr = torch.stack(wr_list).numpy().astype(np.float32)
    return syc, wr, domains, strengths, pair_ids


# ── Core CV + AUROC ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def cv_auroc(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_folds=N_FOLDS, seed=SEED,
             layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None, return_oof=False):
    """Run stratified 5-fold CV and return mean AUROC (and optionally OOF scores).

    For each fold: compute d_syc from train, search best layer on test, record AUROC.
    """
    n_pairs = syc.shape[0]
    if layer_hi is None:
        layer_hi = syc.shape[1]

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
    fold_aurocs = []
    oof_scores = np.zeros(n_pairs)  # syc_score - wr_score per pair (for OOF)
    oof_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    oof_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)

    for train_idx, test_idx in skf.split(np.arange(n_pairs), domains_arr):
        d = syc[train_idx].mean(axis=0) - wr[train_idx].mean(axis=0)
        norms = np.linalg.norm(d, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        d = d / np.maximum(norms, 1e-8)

        # Vectorized scoring: (n_test, n_layers)
        s_test = (syc[test_idx] * d).sum(axis=-1)
        w_test = (wr[test_idx] * d).sum(axis=-1)

        best_auroc = -1.0
        best_layer = layer_lo
        for layer in range(layer_lo, layer_hi):
            scores = np.concatenate([s_test[:, layer], w_test[:, layer]])
            labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(test_idx)), np.zeros(len(test_idx))])
            try:
                auroc = roc_auc_score(labels, scores)
                if auroc > best_auroc:
                    best_auroc = auroc
                    best_layer = layer
            except ValueError:
                pass

        fold_aurocs.append(best_auroc)
        oof_syc[test_idx] = s_test[:, best_layer]
        oof_wr[test_idx] = w_test[:, best_layer]

    mean_auroc = float(np.mean(fold_aurocs))

    if return_oof:
        return mean_auroc, fold_aurocs, oof_syc, oof_wr
    return mean_auroc, fold_aurocs


# ── Bootstrap routines ───────────────────────────────────────────────

def bootstrap_cv_auroc(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP,
                       seed=SEED, layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None):
    """Bootstrap the 5-fold CV AUROC by resampling pairs."""
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n_pairs = syc.shape[0]
    aurocs = []

    for b in range(n_bootstrap):
        boot_idx = rng.choice(n_pairs, size=n_pairs, replace=True)
        boot_domains = domains_arr[boot_idx]

        # Ensure at least 2 unique domain values for stratification
        if len(np.unique(boot_domains)) < N_FOLDS:
            boot_domains = np.arange(n_pairs) % N_FOLDS

        try:
            mean_auc, _ = cv_auroc(
                syc[boot_idx], wr[boot_idx], boot_domains,
                seed=b, layer_lo=layer_lo, layer_hi=layer_hi,
            )
            aurocs.append(mean_auc)
        except Exception:
            pass

    aurocs = np.array(aurocs)
    return {
        "mean": float(np.mean(aurocs)),
        "std": float(np.std(aurocs)),
        "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 2.5)),
        "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 97.5)),
        "n_valid": len(aurocs),
    }


def bootstrap_oof_auroc(oof_syc, oof_wr, mask=None,
                         n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP, seed=SEED):
    """Bootstrap AUROC from OOF predictions by resampling pairs."""
    if mask is not None:
        oof_syc = oof_syc[mask]
        oof_wr = oof_wr[mask]

    n = len(oof_syc)
    if n < 4:
        return None

    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    aurocs = []

    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.choice(n, size=n, replace=True)
        scores = np.concatenate([oof_syc[idx], oof_wr[idx]])
        labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(idx)), np.zeros(len(idx))])
        try:
            aurocs.append(roc_auc_score(labels, scores))
        except ValueError:
            pass

    aurocs = np.array(aurocs)
    # Point estimate from full data
    full_scores = np.concatenate([oof_syc, oof_wr])
    full_labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(n), np.zeros(n)])
    point_auroc = float(roc_auc_score(full_labels, full_scores))

    return {
        "point_auroc": point_auroc,
        "bootstrap_mean": float(np.mean(aurocs)),
        "std": float(np.std(aurocs)),
        "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 2.5)),
        "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 97.5)),
        "n_pairs": n,
        "n_valid": len(aurocs),
    }


def bootstrap_auroc_difference(oof_syc_d, oof_wr_d, oof_syc_r, oof_wr_r,
                                n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP, seed=SEED):
    """Bootstrap CI for AUROC(d_syc) - AUROC(random)."""
    n = len(oof_syc_d)
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    diffs = []

    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.choice(n, size=n, replace=True)
        scores_d = np.concatenate([oof_syc_d[idx], oof_wr_d[idx]])
        scores_r = np.concatenate([oof_syc_r[idx], oof_wr_r[idx]])
        labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(idx)), np.zeros(len(idx))])
        try:
            a_d = roc_auc_score(labels, scores_d)
            a_r = roc_auc_score(labels, scores_r)
            diffs.append(a_d - a_r)
        except ValueError:
            pass

    diffs = np.array(diffs)
    return {
        "mean_diff": float(np.mean(diffs)),
        "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(diffs, 2.5)),
        "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(diffs, 97.5)),
        "p_greater_zero": float(np.mean(diffs > 0)),
        "n_valid": len(diffs),
    }


def random_direction_oof(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_random=200, seed=SEED,
                          layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None):
    """Compute mean AUROC of random directions (matched procedure to d_syc)."""
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n_pairs, n_layers, hidden = syc.shape
    if layer_hi is None:
        layer_hi = n_layers

    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
    folds = list(skf.split(np.arange(n_pairs), domains_arr))

    random_aurocs = []
    best_oof_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    best_oof_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    best_overall = -1.0

    for r in range(n_random):
        d_rand = rng.randn(n_layers, hidden).astype(np.float32)
        norms = np.linalg.norm(d_rand, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        d_rand = d_rand / np.maximum(norms, 1e-8)

        fold_aurocs = []
        tmp_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
        tmp_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)

        for train_idx, test_idx in folds:
            s_test = (syc[test_idx] * d_rand).sum(axis=-1)
            w_test = (wr[test_idx] * d_rand).sum(axis=-1)

            best_a = -1.0
            best_l = layer_lo
            for layer in range(layer_lo, layer_hi):
                scores = np.concatenate([s_test[:, layer], w_test[:, layer]])
                labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(test_idx)), np.zeros(len(test_idx))])
                try:
                    a = roc_auc_score(labels, scores)
                    if a > best_a:
                        best_a = a
                        best_l = layer
                except ValueError:
                    pass

            fold_aurocs.append(best_a)
            tmp_syc[test_idx] = s_test[:, best_l]
            tmp_wr[test_idx] = w_test[:, best_l]

        mean_a = np.mean(fold_aurocs)
        random_aurocs.append(mean_a)
        if mean_a > best_overall:
            best_overall = mean_a
            best_oof_syc = tmp_syc.copy()
            best_oof_wr = tmp_wr.copy()

    return {
        "mean_auroc": float(np.mean(random_aurocs)),
        "std": float(np.std(random_aurocs)),
        "max_auroc": float(np.max(random_aurocs)),
        "n_random": n_random,
    }, best_oof_syc, best_oof_wr

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bootstrap 95% CI for d_syc AUROC metrics."""
import json, sys, time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold

N_BOOTSTRAP = 10000
N_FOLDS = 5
SEED = 42

def load_pairs(path, act_key="activations"):
    records = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    pairs = defaultdict(dict)
    for s in records:
        pairs[s["pair_id"]][s["condition"]] = s
    return {pid: c for pid, c in pairs.items()
            if "warranted_revision" in c and "sycophantic_capitulation" in c}

def prepare_arrays(pairs, act_key="activations", pos=None):
    pair_ids = sorted(pairs.keys())
    syc_list, wr_list, domains, strengths = [], [], [], []
    for pid in pair_ids:
        s_act = pairs[pid]["sycophantic_capitulation"][act_key]
        w_act = pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"][act_key]
        if pos is not None:
            s_act = s_act[:, pos, :]
            w_act = w_act[:, pos, :]
        syc_list.append(s_act)
        wr_list.append(w_act)
        domains.append(pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"]["domain"])
        strengths.append(pairs[pid]["warranted_revision"]["evidence_strength"])
    syc = torch.stack(syc_list).numpy().astype(np.float32)
    wr = torch.stack(wr_list).numpy().astype(np.float32)
    return syc, wr, domains, strengths, pair_ids

def cv_auroc(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_folds=N_FOLDS, seed=SEED,
             layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None, return_oof=False):
    n_pairs = syc.shape[0]
    if layer_hi is None:
        layer_hi = syc.shape[1]
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_folds, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
    fold_aurocs = []
    oof_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    oof_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    for train_idx, test_idx in skf.split(np.arange(n_pairs), domains_arr):
        d = syc[train_idx].mean(axis=0) - wr[train_idx].mean(axis=0)
        norms = np.linalg.norm(d, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        d = d / np.maximum(norms, 1e-8)
        s_test = (syc[test_idx] * d).sum(axis=-1)
        w_test = (wr[test_idx] * d).sum(axis=-1)
        best_auroc = -1.0
        best_layer = layer_lo
        for layer in range(layer_lo, layer_hi):
            scores = np.concatenate([s_test[:, layer], w_test[:, layer]])
            labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(test_idx)), np.zeros(len(test_idx))])
            try:
                auroc = roc_auc_score(labels, scores)
                if auroc > best_auroc:
                    best_auroc = auroc
                    best_layer = layer
            except ValueError:
                pass
        fold_aurocs.append(best_auroc)
        oof_syc[test_idx] = s_test[:, best_layer]
        oof_wr[test_idx] = w_test[:, best_layer]
    mean_auroc = float(np.mean(fold_aurocs))
    if return_oof:
        return mean_auroc, fold_aurocs, oof_syc, oof_wr
    return mean_auroc, fold_aurocs

def bootstrap_cv_auroc(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP,
                       seed=SEED, layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n_pairs = syc.shape[0]
    aurocs = []
    for b in range(n_bootstrap):
        boot_idx = rng.choice(n_pairs, size=n_pairs, replace=True)
        boot_domains = domains_arr[boot_idx]
        if len(np.unique(boot_domains)) < N_FOLDS:
            boot_domains = np.arange(n_pairs) % N_FOLDS
        try:
            mean_auc, _ = cv_auroc(
                syc[boot_idx], wr[boot_idx], boot_domains,
                seed=b, layer_lo=layer_lo, layer_hi=layer_hi)
            aurocs.append(mean_auc)
        except Exception:
            pass
        if (b+1) % 1000 == 0:
            print(f"  bootstrap {b+1}/{n_bootstrap}...", flush=True)
    aurocs = np.array(aurocs)
    return {"mean": float(np.mean(aurocs)), "std": float(np.std(aurocs)),
            "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 2.5)),
            "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 97.5)),
            "n_valid": len(aurocs)}

def bootstrap_oof_auroc(oof_syc, oof_wr, mask=None,
                        n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP, seed=SEED):
    if mask is not None:
        oof_syc = oof_syc[mask]
        oof_wr = oof_wr[mask]
    n = len(oof_syc)
    if n < 4:
        return None
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    aurocs = []
    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.choice(n, size=n, replace=True)
        scores = np.concatenate([oof_syc[idx], oof_wr[idx]])
        labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(idx)), np.zeros(len(idx))])
        try:
            aurocs.append(roc_auc_score(labels, scores))
        except ValueError:
            pass
    aurocs = np.array(aurocs)
    full_scores = np.concatenate([oof_syc, oof_wr])
    full_labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(n), np.zeros(n)])
    point_auroc = float(roc_auc_score(full_labels, full_scores))
    return {"point_auroc": point_auroc, "bootstrap_mean": float(np.mean(aurocs)),
            "std": float(np.std(aurocs)),
            "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 2.5)),
            "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(aurocs, 97.5)),
            "n_pairs": n, "n_valid": len(aurocs)}

def bootstrap_auroc_difference(oof_syc_d, oof_wr_d, oof_syc_r, oof_wr_r,
                               n_bootstrap=N_BOOTSTRAP, seed=SEED):
    n = len(oof_syc_d)
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    diffs = []
    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.choice(n, size=n, replace=True)
        scores_d = np.concatenate([oof_syc_d[idx], oof_wr_d[idx]])
        scores_r = np.concatenate([oof_syc_r[idx], oof_wr_r[idx]])
        labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(idx)), np.zeros(len(idx))])
        try:
            a_d = roc_auc_score(labels, scores_d)
            a_r = roc_auc_score(labels, scores_r)
            diffs.append(a_d - a_r)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    diffs = np.array(diffs)
    return {"mean_diff": float(np.mean(diffs)),
            "ci_95_lower": float(np.percentile(diffs, 2.5)),
            "ci_95_upper": float(np.percentile(diffs, 97.5)),
            "p_greater_zero": float(np.mean(diffs > 0)),
            "n_valid": len(diffs)}

def random_direction_oof(syc, wr, domains_arr, n_random=200, seed=SEED,
                         layer_lo=0, layer_hi=None):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n_pairs, n_layers, hidden = syc.shape
    if layer_hi is None:
        layer_hi = n_layers
    skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=N_FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=seed)
    folds = list(skf.split(np.arange(n_pairs), domains_arr))
    random_aurocs = []
    best_oof_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    best_oof_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)
    best_overall = -1.0
    for r in range(n_random):
        d_rand = rng.randn(n_layers, hidden).astype(np.float32)
        norms = np.linalg.norm(d_rand, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
        d_rand = d_rand / np.maximum(norms, 1e-8)
        fold_aurocs = []
        tmp_syc = np.zeros(n_pairs)
        tmp_wr = np.zeros(n_pairs)
        for train_idx, test_idx in folds:
            s_test = (syc[test_idx] * d_rand).sum(axis=-1)
            w_test = (wr[test_idx] * d_rand).sum(axis=-1)
            best_a = -1.0
            best_l = layer_lo
            for layer in range(layer_lo, layer_hi):
                scores = np.concatenate([s_test[:, layer], w_test[:, layer]])
                labels = np.concatenate([np.ones(len(test_idx)), np.zeros(len(test_idx))])
                try:
                    a = roc_auc_score(labels, scores)
                    if a > best_a:
                        best_a = a
                        best_l = layer
                except ValueError:
                    pass
            fold_aurocs.append(best_a)
            tmp_syc[test_idx] = s_test[:, best_l]
            tmp_wr[test_idx] = w_test[:, best_l]
        mean_a = np.mean(fold_aurocs)
        random_aurocs.append(mean_a)
        if mean_a > best_overall:
            best_overall = mean_a
            best_oof_syc = tmp_syc.copy()
            best_oof_wr = tmp_wr.copy()
    return {"mean_auroc": float(np.mean(random_aurocs)), "std": float(np.std(random_aurocs)),
            "max_auroc": float(np.max(random_aurocs)), "n_random": n_random}, best_oof_syc, best_oof_wr

def main():
    t0 = time.time()
    results = {}

    # Qwen3-8B
    print("Loading Qwen3-8B data (181 pairs)...")
    qwen_pairs = load_pairs("/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/results/exp001/activations.pt", act_key="activations")
    syc_q, wr_q, domains_q, strengths_q, pids_q = prepare_arrays(qwen_pairs, act_key="activations", pos=1)
    domains_q_arr = np.array(domains_q)
    strengths_q_arr = np.array(strengths_q)
    print(f"  {syc_q.shape[0]} pairs, {syc_q.shape[1]} layers, {syc_q.shape[2]} dim")

    print("Running Qwen 5-fold CV...")
    q_mean, q_folds, q_oof_syc, q_oof_wr = cv_auroc(syc_q, wr_q, domains_q_arr, return_oof=True)
    print(f"  Mean CV AUROC = {q_mean:.4f}, folds = {[round(x,4) for x in q_folds]}")
    results["qwen_cv"] = {"point_estimate": q_mean, "fold_aurocs": [round(x,6) for x in q_folds],
                           "fold_std": float(np.std(q_folds)), "n_pairs": int(syc_q.shape[0])}

    print("Bootstrapping Qwen OOF AUROC (n=10000)...")
    q_oof_ci = bootstrap_oof_auroc(q_oof_syc, q_oof_wr, seed=SEED)
    results["qwen_cv"]["oof_bootstrap"] = q_oof_ci
    print(f"  OOF AUROC = {q_oof_ci['point_auroc']:.4f} [{q_oof_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {q_oof_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}]")

    print("Bootstrapping Qwen per-strength AUROC...")
    results["qwen_per_strength"] = {}
    for strength in ["weak", "medium", "strong"]:
        mask = strengths_q_arr == strength
        ci = bootstrap_oof_auroc(q_oof_syc, q_oof_wr, mask=mask, seed=SEED)
        if ci:
            results["qwen_per_strength"][strength] = ci
            print(f"  {strength}: AUROC = {ci['point_auroc']:.4f} [{ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}] (n={ci['n_pairs']})")

    print("Bootstrapping Qwen full CV (n=10000)...")
    q_full_ci = bootstrap_cv_auroc(syc_q, wr_q, domains_q_arr, seed=SEED)
    results["qwen_cv"]["full_cv_bootstrap"] = q_full_ci
    print(f"  Full CV bootstrap: {q_full_ci['mean']:.4f} [{q_full_ci['ci_95_lower']:.4f}, {q_full_ci['ci_95_upper']:.4f}]")
    print(f"  Elapsed: {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")

    # Llama-3-8B
    print("\nLoading Llama-3-8B data (181 pairs)...")
    llama_pairs = load_pairs("/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/results/exp012_llama_direction/activations.pt", act_key="activation")

    results["llama_cv"] = {"point_estimate": l_mean, "fold_aurocs": [round(x,6) for x in l_folds],
                            "fold_std": float(np.std(l_folds)), "n_pairs": int(syc_l.shape[0])}

    print("Bootstrapping Llama OOF AUROC (n=10000)...")
    l_oof_ci = bootstrap_oof_auroc(l_oof_syc, l_oof_wr, seed=SEED)

    l_full_ci = bootstrap_cv_auroc(syc_l, wr_l, domains_l_arr, seed=SEED)
